method.order: round -> scenario -> version (old,new on even round+scenario, new,old otherwise) -> transport (tcp,kcp on odd rounds, kcp,tcp on even rounds); serial, no builds during measurement
method.kcp: fast; nodelay/10ms/fastresend=2/nocwnd, snd/rcv=32/128, MTU=1400; no parameter changes
method.netem: 10ms each direction for non-clean; random loss with seed42; limit10000; no bandwidth limit; reset per invocation
method.accounting: requests independently counted after local enqueue, window determined by send start; payload checked replies only; received-only RTT quantiles; 500ms tail is not a strict wall-clock deadline; qdisc includes setup/warmup/both cells
method.comparison: new paired end-to-end measurements, not replayed packet traces; host not a dedicated benchmark machine; historical 0.5.2 stored separately

meta.source_comparison: Only Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock differ between baseline and candidate snapshots; same new dependency-contract tests on both; src/ and benches/ unchanged from base_commit.

local_validation.prek_initial: 13 hooks passed; final pre-commit status is recorded in the PR

reproduction.notes: Archival scripts actually executed inside dedicated container; both builds completed first; no host qdisc. Extract runner sources after preparing /work/old, /work/new and binaries. Followup is selected post-hoc and kept separate, not pooled. See accompanying Markdown for setup.
